short: The commission JSON API, one file per act
is: The user-scoped commission API, one file per act, all behind a uniform closed-door 404 for non-participants — each act a thin driver over the matching `application::commission::*` use case.
conventions: Commissions are user-scoped — no Account required (DD 26247170) — and entirely Index-side (never touch atproto).
Existence is participant-only knowledge: non-participants and absent ids get the same 404, never a 403.
A new act adds a file here rather than growing a hotspot.

The handler shape (ZMVP-205): `CallingUser` in, then the `{id}` through `CommissionPath` (a malformed id answers the same 404 as an id that names nothing; a second path parameter keeps its own `Path` extraction, the id read there as `IgnoredAny`), then `state.app().commissions().<act>(command, now)`, with the error mapped through the shared `CommissionError → Problem` impl in `mod.rs` — no handler builds a ports struct or opens a transaction.
`channel.rs` and `elements.rs` are the two exceptions: no use case covers them, so they keep `require_owner` (the last driver-side authz) plus an inline unit of work until one exists.

The interim guard (until ARC-4 moves them into use cases): `channel.rs`'s and `elements.rs`'s six calls on a unit's `commissions()` and `changelog()` each carry `#[expect(clippy::disallowed_methods, reason = "ARC-4 moves this into a use case")]` on its own statement, under api/clippy.toml's ban; a new call fails clippy.
entry_points: mod.rs (router assembly + the CommissionError → Problem mapping)

fs.name: channel.rs
fs.role: PUT/DELETE /{id}/channel linked-channel pointer — NOT migrated: no use case exists, so require_owner + an inline UnitOfWork stay (TODO(engineer)); link_channel keeps its #[deprecated]

fs.name: create.rs
fs.role: POST /commissions → commission::create, which answers the created row read back by id; rendered into CreateCommissionResponse; a blank title or one the name rule refuses → 422 with a field error at #/title

fs.name: deadline.rs
fs.role: PUT/DELETE deadline + manual Delayed flag → commission::deadline::* and deadline::status::*

fs.name: elements.rs
fs.role: POST/DELETE elements, the flat composition write surface — NOT migrated: no use case exists, so require_owner + an inline UnitOfWork stay (TODO(engineer))

fs.name: files.rs
fs.role: multipart upload / download → commission::files::upload / download; HTTP streaming glue stays here

fs.name: mod.rs
fs.role: router assembly, body limits, the CommissionError→Problem mapping, title_write_problem (create's and rename's name-rule refusal as a field error at #/title; slots and files keep the plain mapping), and require_owner — the last driver-side gate, kept only for the unmigrated channel/elements acts

fs.name: positioning.rs
fs.role: account-side placement + view grants → commission::place, view::grant / view::revoke; grants are per-User (DD 29130754 amended 2026-09-04), so the route's {account_id} segment is dead (TODO(engineer))

fs.name: rename.rs
fs.role: PATCH /{id}/title → commission::rename, owner-only; the path's id wins over the body's; answers the renamed row read back by id, rendered into RenameCommissionResponse; a refused title → 422 with a field error at #/title

fs.name: seats.rs
fs.role: POST /{id}/seats — declare a vacant typed Seat → commission::seats::declare

fs.name: tests.rs
fs.role: unit tests for mod.rs's CommissionError→Problem mapping

notes: `unknown_surface` is `422` not `404`: the `(tab, surface)` skeleton is code-declared and global, so an undeclared pair is a program fact, not a per-commission one — contrast `tab_not_found`/`element_not_found` (404, per-row, cross-commission collapse).
`SeatNotFound` maps to `element_not_found` (a Seat is an Element).
